description: Create a MySQL database and a database user on a GlobalHostia hosting service. The panel adds the account prefix to both names (e.g. "shop" becomes "bob_shop"). A strong random password is set and never shown; the customer sets their own in the control panel before use.

service_id.description: Hosting service id, as returned by the matching list tool.

user.description: User name without the prefix (default: same as name)

name: create_database
title: Create a MySQL database
